$comment: Weekly live API smoke table (#2600). One row per funded provider; the row
name is the job name and the commit-status context, so the checks tab
explains itself. Adding a provider is a row plus a repository secret named
by key_secret — never a workflow edit. A row whose secret is unset reports
a visible skip notice and a pending commit status, never a pass.
protocol selects which of lintro's own API providers drives the call:
'anthropic' and 'openai' are the two wire protocols lintro implements, and
gateways (kimi, z.ai) reuse them through base_url.
